notes.title: SOS.... MAYDAY....
notes.notes:
[p] Ship.... down. Repeat, ship is down on a frosaken world.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Hull compromised[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Systems failing.[/p][p][/p][p]They left me for [b]dead[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]The surface is.... crawling. Endless waves of [b]vicious pixel-art monstrosities[/b].[/p][p]
They keep coming. They.... they overwhelm me.[/p][p][/p][p]But... something is wrong. [b]Death[/b] isn't the end here. It [b]is[/b]... [b]fuel[/b]. Every time they tear me apart, I'm... [b]reborn[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]I can feel the [b]power[/b] building. A storm is brewing inside me.[/p][p][/p][h1][b][u]NANOSTORM IS NOW AVAILABLE.[/u][/b] [/h1][p][/p][h2]GET IT![/h2][p][/p][h3]EXPERIENCE THE NANOSTORM.[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
